record.question: Which of the following is false regarding corruption laws in India?
options: Bribery by "treating" (food, drink, entertainment, or provision) is considered less severe and punishable with fine only and no imprisonment.
If a public servant refuses bribe, the act of bribery remains unfulfilled and therefore the person offering the bribe cannot be prosecuted.
Private bank employees are considered as public servants therefore they face the same rules and regulations regarding corruption as the "regular" public servants.
There is no formal law regarding bribing private/corporate enterprises; however, such can be considered a case of fraud which is punishable.
